# FDA approvals on track for record year

## With 47 approvals through October, CDER has already approved more drugs than in 35 of the past 41 years

 By Meredith Durkin Wolfe, Director of Research 

November 10, 2026 9:50 PM UTC

FDA’s Center for Drug Evaluation and Research approved 47 new molecular entities and new BLAs (NMEs) through the end of October, a figure tied with the first 10 months of 2018 and ahead of every other year since FDA began publishing records in 1985.

Two years, 2018 and 1996, are tied for the highest full-year approval number on record, at 59. This year’s total could go higher, as December is typically the most prolific month for new approvals...
